messages.content: 我正在嘗試根據“Pantone”標準找出顏色“天藍色”的RGB值。其次，我有興趣購買一把在“洛杉磯”出售的二手“Fender Stratocaster”吉他，狀況為“良好”。你能幫我查詢價格嗎？最後，我正在紐約組織一場國際象棋錦標賽，我正在尋找最佳的選手邀請。你能幫我找出最低等級為2200的前15名選手嗎？

1) Identify RGB values of Pantone color “天蓝色”. Use identify_color_rgb with color_name="天蓝色", standard="pantone".

2) Get price of second-hand Fender Stratocaster in Los Angeles, good condition.

Use guitar_price_find with model="Fender Stratocaster", condition="Good", location="Los Angeles". But note that the tool expects condition options: "Poor","Good","Excellent". Good matches.
